The '''2002–03 Egyptian Premier League''' was the forty-sixth season of the [[Egyptian Premier League]] since its establishment in 1948. The season began on 23 September 2002 and concluded on 23 May 2003, with a total of 14 teams contesting the league. [[Zamalek SC|Zamalek]] won the title, with [[Al-Ahly S.C.|Al Ahly]] being the runner up.<ref>{{cite web|title=Egyptian football network|url=https://www.angelfire.com/ak/EgyptianSports/foot.html}}</ref>
